lines.en: To the real home.
But Axelrod Adamson stayed tied to a chair.
: I don’t know! Maybe your voice just has some kind of reverse effect on my ears? Or maybe I just understand everything you’re going to say before you even say it?
: Ooh! Maybe I have Sana-vision?! That sounds like a cool power — always being able to see what you think or mean! Barring all of that stuff you said about wanting to be raped in an alley, of course.
: I thought we...weren’t going to talk about that again?...
: Just to other people. We can still discuss our crazy fetishes with each other.
: What the fuck is this?
: Oh, hey Makoto! Did you hear that? Sana and I were just talking about the time Nodoka tricked us into having a friend-orgy thing. But, since you were there-
: No, I mean what the fuck is this?!
: I think it’s called a...party?...
: No! I...I went back to the past! And then there was a...me without a face...and a clown! And now I’m back here?! How?!
: Uh-oh...Makoto caught the Sensei disease where her...memories are always weird and wrong...
: Joking aside, do you need to go outside for a minute? Sounds to me like you might be having a-
: I’m fine! Just...tell me where Sensei is! I need to talk to him!
: Sensei? He just left with that extremely creepy yet oddly lovable child who was here just a minute ago. Were you zoning out for the whole scene?
: You might...still be able to catch him if you...run?...

: You could always use your phone too. It’s not like we’re trapped in some dated movie where every time there’s drama that needs to be resolved, the characters suddenly can’t get into contact with one another.
: Cool, thanks! Bye!
: I feel like...what you just said...might be a little too on the nose given that...it’s probably going to happen now...
: Or at least it was going to happen. But the fact that you openly acknowledged it adds another dimension where it’s now expected to go like that. Which means it won’t.
: So what happens if I...agree and...the two of us...land on the same conclusion?...
: I’m not sure. But if I were a director, I’d seize that opportunity to cut back to the main character and abruptly fade out our-
: Come on, come on, come on!
: We’re sorry. Your call can not be completed as dialed. Please hang up and-
: Fuck! Are you serious right now?! I can’t run in this costume! It’s way too tight!
: ...and then we’d cut right back in as soon as another segue is needed!
: Oh...look...Ami and Maya finally made it...

: Well, I see that Ayane’s taste in decor is just as odd and thematically confused as always. At least I can take comfort in that while I’m watching the man I love put his penis inside of my best friend.
: You’ll keep me company even if things go horribly, right? Because I’m not exactly liked around here anymore and I won’t be able to stop anybody if they all try to jump me and take my things.
: Give me your phone right now!
: Ahh! It’s already happening!
: Why am I being touched?
: Because Sensei just disappeared with a small child and I need to act right now before anything happens to him!
: Should we...not be more worried about the small child?
: What small child? It wasn’t Nao-chan, was it? Because me and Maya just came in through the main entrance and didn’t see either one of them.
: It might also help to know where they’re going. Ami and I sort of need Sensei to be here in order to complete our mission.
: I don’t care about your mission, just give me your phone. I already tried calling him from mine but I couldn’t get through.
: Sure, yeah. I can  put aside my unending hate for you if it means helping Sensei. You do seem really worried, so...I’m going to trust you here, Makoto. Don’t let me down.
: Sure. Yeah. Phone.
: What happens if he’s just...not here for the rest of the night? Because the entire reason I even came to this thing in the first place was try and “drag him back.”
: I’m aggressive Maya right now. I don’t have time to waste mingling with 95%% of my enemies while the one man I have ever cared about fucks his childhood friend and “Nao-chan” at the same time.

: If he’s not here, we can leave. You, me, and Makoto can split up and look for him. But this just means we’re probably going to have to turn the threesome into a foursome to pay her back for her hard work.
: Ugh. I can only allow so many more people into this affair before I have to start questioning my logic in just what I’m willing to do to pursue him.
: What the fuck are you guys even-
: We’re sorry. Your call can not be completed as dialed. Please hang up and-
: FUCKING HELL!
: Take your stupid phone back! I’ll just figure something else out! I’ll- Ayane! Right! Maybe she got sent back too?!
: Sent back to where?

: If he’s not here, we can leave. You, me, and Makoto can split up and look for him. But this just means we’re probably going to have to turn the threesome into a foursome to pay her back for her hard work.
: What? Didn’t you already say that?
: Ayane!
: Not right now, Makoto. I’m brooding over the fact that I just lost to a little girl.
: Brood later! Has anything weird happened to you over the last few minutes?!
: Did I mention the fact that I just lost to a little girl? If I can’t win him over in a red leather suit, when can I, Makoto? This is getting ridiculous.
: Weirder! Like, reset-adjacent weird! Because I’m pretty sure I just went through one!
: Wait, what? But we were talking about slumber parties like five minutes ago. How is that even possible?
: I don’t know! I...I mean...maybe that’s not what it was! But I went back to the first Halloween and...everything was different.
: Different how?...
: Just...everything. Ami was Sensei’s actual daughter and her mom never died. You never started sleeping with him. And also, I may have had a threesome while I was there. But that’s beside the point!
: Then why would you even bring it up?!
: I don’t know! It’s not like it was a goal of mine! I just got pressured into it! And it only happened because Sensei was there too!
: Well, I’d sure hope so! Because if you just had a threesome with two of our classmates, I’d really start to question your feelings for him!
: No, no, no! Our Sensei! He went back with me!
: He...what?
: Yeah! But then some weird shit happened to me and I got pulled back here. But I don’t know if he did too since I can’t get through to him.
: And if he’s not himself right now and we really are rapidly spiraling into another reset out of nowhere, I’m worried he might stay gone for good.
: I knew it...
: ...Ayane?
: I knew something was wrong...I felt it...But he just kept saying he needed to go and...I just let it happen...
: I should’ve kept him here...I should have grabbed his arm and held on like both of our lives depended on it...but I just let him go...
: Y...Yes. But we don’t know for sure that this is actually happening yet! Which is why we need to find him and then hold onto him. There’s no time to feel sorry for ourselves right now.
: Ayane...
: You’re right! Playtime’s over! I can feel sorry for myself after we track down our teacher!
: Wow, you really don’t let yourself wallow in misery for long at all, do you?

: Nope! It’s both my greatest strength and biggest weakness! But that’s beside the point! The first thing we need to do is try and figure out where he went. You said you already tried calling him, right?
: I’ve tried from two separate phones — which leads me to believe that there is some external source preventing us from digitally contacting him.
: Or the service is just really bad over here. You’re connected to the WiFi, right? The password is Geoffrey1.

: I’m already connected. But I can try calling again once we’re a little further away from the mansion if you think it’ll work. Also, Ami and Maya just showed up and I think they’re going to help us too.
: Great. Now, we just have to figure out where to look.
: And thanks for finally taking some initiative, Makoto. I have a really good feeling about this if both of us are going to be doing our best.
: Thank me later. I’ve got a good feeling too.
: Ayane?
: Hey, where’d Ayane go? Weren’t the two of you just-
: What the-
: The hell is that noise?
: Did...
: Did Miku just...
: I don’t feel so good.
: This...can’t be real.
: What...the actual fuck...is happening?...
: I don’t know...
: But whatever it is...it’s not good.
: Oh, you think?!
: Um...does anyone else by any chance...
: Feel the ground moving?...
: GUESS WHO’S BACK
